value: The right of rectification allows you to correct inaccurate data concerning you or to complete data in relation to the purpose of the processing.

label: ERASURE
value: The right to erasure allows you to have your data erased where the grounds set out in Article 17 of the GDPR apply.

label: TO THE LIMITATION OF PROCESSING
value: This right allows you to obtain, if you contest the accuracy of the data used by the organization or object to your data being processed, the suspension of processing for a certain period of time.

label: PORTABILITY
value: this right allows you to recover the data you have provided to a platform, for personal use or to transmit them to a third party of your choice.

label: OPPOSITION
value: This right allows you to object at any time, for reasons relating to your particular situation, to the processing of your personal data.

label: WITHDRAWAL OF YOUR CONSENT
value: This right allows you to withdraw your consent to the processing of your data at any time.

label: A DIGITAL DEATH
value: This right, applicable in France, allows you to define post-mortem directives concerning the fate of your data.
